Whereas:

(1)

The protection of test subjects is a fundamental concern of this Regulation(1).

(2)

Providers should keep adequate records of their test activities.

CHAPTER I

General provisions

Article 1

Subject matter

This Regulation lays down rules on the testing of widgets in the Union.

Article 2

Obligations of providers

1. Providers shall:

(a)

keep records of every widget test for a period of ten years after the test;

(b)

notify the competent authority of every failed widget test without undue delay.

Where the competent authority so requests, providers shall also:

(a)

provide the records referred to in point (a) of the first subparagraph;

2. Paragraph 1 shall not apply to widgets used solely for research.

ANNEX I

List of test widgets

The following widgets are covered:

1. Mechanical widgets used in consumer products.

2. Electronic widgets used in critical infrastructure.
